# show_percolated_paths_as_df { #mofography.data.show_percolated_paths_as_df }

```python
data.show_percolated_paths_as_df(paths, path_windows, path_lengths)
```

Build a sorted DataFrame of pore-graph paths, window diameters along each path, and hop counts.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                                              | Default    |
|--------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| paths        |        | A list of paths, where each entry represent teh index of a pocket/node on the pore graph | _required_ |
| path_windows |        | Path windows are the sizes of the windows encountered along the path                     | _required_ |
| path_lengths |        | The number of jumps or edges along the path                                              | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                              |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The function `show_percolated_paths_as_df` is returning a pandas DataFrame sorted by the path lengths, where the columns show the paths, path windows, and path lengths. |
